result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section after "Longest Duplicates". The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or generate a report to check the output.

- **Report:** `DuplicationReportGenerator.java` already had an unused `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList` method. It builds the section, with the description "The list of N most frequently found duplicates." and the same table as Longest Duplicates, and leaves it out when there are no such duplicates. I added the call to it right after `addLongestDuplicatesList`, with the usual stopwatch markers.
- **Code fragments:** in `DataExporter.java`, when `saveCodeFragments` is on, the most frequent duplicates are now saved as `most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>`, next to the longest-duplicate and unit-duplicate fragments.

I made no commit.
